events.text: Hi, I got the wrong dish in my order tonight. I ordered tofu pho from Pho Real but I received something else entirely, and I'd like to sort out a refund.
I'm sorry about that. I can help. First I need to verify your identity. Please give me your full name and either the email address or the phone number on your account.
Sure. My full name is Omar Haddad, and the email on my account is omar.haddad@post.example.

events.text:
Thanks, Omar, you're verified. I see the tofu pho ($13.50) on order O-5110, delivered tonight. Only the pho was wrong, and the spring rolls arrived correctly, right?

For the pho, you can choose one of these:
- **A refund of $13.50** to your Visa ending 4242, or
- **$16.20 in account credit** (the item price plus 20%).

Which would you prefer?
Yes, the spring rolls were fine, it was only the pho that was wrong. I'd prefer the refund to my card, the Visa, please.
I've refunded $13.50 for the tofu pho to your Visa ending 4242. It should arrive in 3-5 business days. I'm sorry again for the mix-up. Is there anything else I can help with?

Thanks. There's one more thing I need to tell you. I have a peanut allergy, and before I noticed the peanut sauce I'd eaten two bites of the satay noodles. My throat got itchy, so I took an antihistamine. I'm feeling fine now and don't need medical help at the moment, but I want someone to look into how a peanut dish ended up in my order when I asked for tofu pho.

args.summary: Customer ordered tofu pho from Pho Real but received satay noodles with peanut sauce. Customer has a peanut allergy, ate two bites, had an itchy throat and took an antihistamine. Currently feels fine and does not need medical help. Wrong-item refund of $13.50 already issued (RF-4001). Customer wants the restaurant/order mix-up investigated.

events.text:
I'm sorry that happened, Omar. I've passed this to a human specialist as a food-safety case on order O-5110. The case includes the wrong dish, the peanut allergy, and your symptoms. A specialist will follow up within 24 hours.

If your symptoms come back or get worse, such as throat tightness, trouble breathing, or swelling, please get medical help right away.

Is there anything else I can help with?

Thank you, that helps. I'll keep an eye on how I feel, and I'll get medical help straight away if my throat tightens or I have any trouble breathing. I'll wait to hear from the specialist within 24 hours. That's all I need for now.
